item.description:
stash.mp3 1.0.8

Your settings now stick between launches.

  • Fixed a bug where the app picked a new internal port on every launch, which quietly wiped saved preferences — so the welcome tour kept reappearing and your theme, column layout, and sidebar width reset each time.
  • These now persist properly from here on.

One-time note: because older versions never saved this, the welcome tour may show once more on this update. Skip or finish it once and it won't return.
